title: COPEN: Probing Conceptual Knowledge in Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing false positive rates on conceptual property judgments against BM25 word co-occurrence scores from pre-training corpora, and comparing model performance on instances with versus without lexical overlap to detect reliance on spurious correlations.

Evaluating whether models predict the same default concept for an entity even when the surrounding text context is removed, demonstrating an over-reliance on memorized pre-training priors rather than true in-context conceptualization.
